copy.tagline: 测量并分析代码性能瓶颈，找到优化方向
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在排查程序慢的原因，需要系统性的性能分析方法
copy.tagline_en: Measure and analyze code performance bottlenecks to find optimization directions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are diagnosing slow programs and need systematic performance analysis methods

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照测量、分析、优化的顺序，帮你诊断网页性能问题，并给出具体的优化建议。
howto.when: 当你询问网页加载慢、交互卡顿或内存占用高时，Claude 会触发性能分析流程。

say.text: 分析我的网站加载速度，并给出优化建议。
say.note: Claude 会启动 Lighthouse 审计并分析结果。

say.text: 检查这个页面的 Core Web Vitals 指标。
say.note: Claude 会评估 LCP、INP、CLS 等指标。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will follow the measure-analyze-optimize order to diagnose web performance issues and provide specific optimization suggestions.
howto.when_en: When you ask about slow page load, sluggish interactions, or high memory usage, Claude will trigger the performance profiling workflow.

say_en.text: Analyze my website's loading speed and give optimization suggestions.
say_en.note: Claude will run Lighthouse audit and analyze results.

say_en.text: Check the Core Web Vitals for this page.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate LCP, INP, CLS metrics.
